name: Break-even ROAS calculator
blurb: The lowest ROAS where your ads stop losing money, with fees, shipping and returns counted. Gives you the target ROAS to enter in Google Ads.

name: UTM link builder
blurb: Tagged links that land in the right GA4 channel. Flags capitals, spaces and mediums GA4 won't recognise, fixes them in one click, and does a whole spreadsheet at once.

name: Search result preview
blurb: See exactly where Google cuts your title, meta description and search ad, by real pixel width, on desktop and mobile side by side.

name: Search ad checker
blurb: Catch the responsive search ad mistakes Google's editor lets through: limits, near-duplicates, pins that box you in, and banned punctuation. Shuffle through the real ads your pins allow.

name: Merchant Center feed checker
blurb: Drop in a product feed and every row Google would reject or limit turns red, with the reason in plain English, before you upload it. Nothing leaves your browser.
